audience: engineers who want observable agent behavior
problem: A strong model can still ship brittle work when the surrounding loop rushes into edits, skips research, guesses while tools are running, or stops without checking the result.
solution: Study local ChatGPT Work behavior as the reference process, write the behavior into a durable mode specification, and teach Kilo and OpenCode to follow the same research, waiting, task-splitting, and verification habits.
mechanism: separate ChatGPT Work from other Codex surfaces
measure tool order and task-splitting behavior
implement paired Kilo and OpenCode modes
replay matched Work tasks and score observable outcomes

evidence.claim: The repository treats local ChatGPT Work transcripts as the process reference.
The repository has written a Codex-imitate mode and paired Kilo/OpenCode modes.
A process scorer checks look-first, wait/send order, writes, and post-edit verification.
Matched-task replay across long Work threads is still in progress.

boundaries: This is not a SWE-bench or Terminal-Bench project.
Raw JSONL, SQLite, and chat bodies stay out of Git.
Codex Work behavior is the chosen gold process for this project.
A process score is not the same as reliable task outcome.
The mode is a wrapper and workflow contract, not a new Codex clone.
